response.text: {"label": "protocol_misunderstanding", "reason": "The sub never connects rxd to the uart instance, and it gates m_axis_tready on m_axis_tdata already being A5, so the line idles low and no byte ever arrives: frame_error repeats every ~380 cycles (`382 ... rx frame_error 1` through `6842 ... rx frame_error 1`). Gold's `153 ... rx hs 3c` and `154 ... rx hs a5` therefore never occur."}
